title: Consolidated prefix bloom + content-fingerprint dedupe for embedding cache
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Improve embeddings & reranking endpoint throughput and latency by implementing a two-tier deduplication pipeline: a lightweight prefix-aware Bloom filter front door to avoid unnecessary embed calls, plus a content-fingerprint (shingle + hashing) verification pass to reduce false positives. This ticket covers design, prototype, perf evaluation, rollout plan, and observability for the new cache/dedupe layer.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end reduction in embedding compute calls >= 18% on representative query traces
P95 embedding latency for cached prefixes reduced by >= 15ms vs baseline
False-positive rate from Bloom+fingerprint stage < 0.5% for production cohorts
Feature gated behind 'prefix_dedupe_v2' and rolloutable per-tenant
Instrumentation and dashboards added: dedupe/hit/miss counters, bloom-fp false-positive alerts, per-tenant savings metrics
comments: 2025-09-18 Sofia Alvarez: Initial proposal. Rationale: current embed cache sees repeated prefix patterns from chat prompts and metadata vectors—significant waste on identical or semantically near-identical inputs. Using a probabilistic front-door avoids full fingerprint compute for most requests.

2025-10-02 Marcus Patel: Spike complete. Implemented prototype Bloom filter keyed on prefix hash + tenant namespace. Measured 24% reduction in embed RPCs on sampled internal chat corpus (week-of-traffic). Memory: ~2.4MB per shard for Bloom parameters targeting 0.5% FPR. CPU overhead negligible for most requests; fingerprint path adds ~1.8ms median extra when invoked.

2025-11-05 Engineering review: Trade-offs discussed — Bloom false positives vs extra fingerprint cost; decided to add a second verification pass (shingled content fingerprint salted per-cohort) to lower end-to-end FPR. Also agreed on two-tier cache: tenant-local LRU + global TTL coalescer for cross-tenant hot prefixes.

2025-12-12 Design feedback (Ava Kim): Ensure prefix canonicalization rules documented (trim whitespace, normalize unicode, remove standard stop tokens). Update SDK docs to show behavior for function-calling prompts.

2026-01-20 Marcus Patel: Canary results (1% traffic) — embed calls down 21%, p99 latency improved 9% for rerank flows. Observed small cohort of long prompts where shingling increased fingerprint time; added bypass config for length > 4k tokens.

2026-02-14 QA: Found an edge where tenant-specific salts changed after migration causing cold misses and spike in embed calls. Mitigation: default to historical salt mapping for 30 days and backfill popular keys asynchronously.

2026-03-10 Marcus Patel: PR merged for core bloom + fingerprint library, runtime flag added, dashboards live. Remaining: rollout to Dedicated customers (needs RBAC opt-in), add automated false-positive regression alerting, and finalize docs. Moving to In Progress -> In Review for release gating.
notes: Design decisions: Use prefix windowing of 128 characters for Bloom keys; use 3 independent hash functions; tune Bloom size per-shard based on tenant QPS quartile.
Verification fingerprint: 5-shingle rolling hash (64-bit) + salted XXH3-64 for stable fast hashing. Salt rotates per-cohort to limit accidental cross-tenant collisions.

Invalidation policy: time-based TTL per key (default 24h) with cohort-driven proactive invalidation when model weighting or quantization changes are deployed. Add ability to invalidate by content-hash prefix range.

Fallback behavior: on Bloom hit -> compute fingerprint -> check canonicalized content against cache -> if miss, compute embedding normally and populate both caches. Bloom miss -> compute embedding directly.
Operational runbook: if false-positive alert fires (>0.5% over 10m), rollback feature flag for affected shards and mitigate by increasing fingerprint verification fraction.

Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout: dev -> internal canary 1% -> regional 10% -> global 50% -> 100%. Dedicated deployments opt-in via console toggle. Monitor cost savings and user-visible quality regressions via A/B prompts set.
Perf targets: keep added median CPU < 0.8ms per request for fingerprint path; memory overhead amortized across shards < 5MB per shard for Bloom structures.
